title: Missing device ids
prompt: Not every error comes from a device, so `device_id` is empty on some `error_events` rows. What does this program print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
devices = error_events.rdd.map(lambda r: r["device_id"])
print(devices.collect())
print(devices.filter(lambda d: d is not None).count())
print(api_requests.rdd.filter(lambda r: r["status_code"] > 500).count())
hints: An empty value in a row comes back to Python as `None`, and `map` keeps it.
Count the items that are not `None`.
`> 500` is not the same as `>= 500`. Look at the highest status code in `api_requests`.
explanation: `map` keeps one item per row, and an empty `device_id` arrives in Python as `None`, so the list has four items, two of them `None`. Two errors have a device. The only failed request with a 5xx code is exactly 500, and `500 > 500` is `False`, so the last count is 0.
